source: ESPN public injury report and game summaries

injuries.name: Norman Powell
injuries.short_comment: Powell has been diagnosed with a mild right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated later this week.
injuries.long_comment: Powell sustained the hamstring injury in Friday's loss to the Wizards and is now set to miss at least the next two contests. With the veteran swingman on the shelf, Isaac Okoro, Buddy Hield, Tre Jones and Patrick Williams are all candidates for increased playing time.

injuries.name: Jalen Smith
injuries.short_comment: Smith (illness) is out for Friday's game against the Wizards, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.
injuries.long_comment: With Smith unavailable after being downgraded to questionable earlier Friday, Chicago will need to cover his center minutes elsewhere. His absence opens up added frontcourt work most prominently for Zach Collins and Nic Claxton, the latter of whom is the likelier candidate to start at center.

injuries.name: Patrick Williams
injuries.short_comment: Williams is probable for Sunday's game against the Nuggets due to a left thumb sprain.
injuries.long_comment: Williams is dealing with a sprained thumb on his non-shooting hand, but he's expected to play through it. Williams is averaging 6.9 points and 1.9 assists per game this season.

injuries.name: Caleb Wilson
injuries.short_comment: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
injuries.long_comment: The rookie forward went down during Wednesday's loss to the Spurs, and he now needs surgery to repair a fractured right hand. More pressure will likely fall on Josh Giddey going forward, while the likes of Tre Jones and Isaac Okoro will have a chance for added streaming value.

injuries.name: Tobe Awaka
injuries.short_comment: Awaka (back) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Nets.
injuries.long_comment: Awaka is missing a fifth straight contest due to a back problem. The rookie big man can be considered week-to-week going forward.

injuries.name: Julian Strawther
injuries.short_comment: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.
injuries.long_comment: Strawther suffered the injury in Wednesday's preseason game against the Clippers. The 24-year-old has appeared in 172 regular-season games for the Nuggets since entering the league in 2023, averaging 7.1 points, 2.0 rebounds and 1.1 assists over 16.2 minutes per contest. He was in line to compete for an expanded role during the 2026-27 campaign. While that may be the case once Strawther is cleared to suit up, Tyus Jones and potentially Ryan Nembhard are candidates to receive more minutes in the interim.
